tasks.task: Build or fix one API endpoint

items.when: Before any code, to agree method, path, who may call it, the body and every response
When the endpoint is one of several and routes, status codes and paging must match
When the contract is agreed and you write validation, errors and tests in Node or Python
When the endpoint works by hand and needs integration and contract tests with fixtures
Before merging, to score naming and errors and flag anything that breaks existing callers

tasks.task: Build a webhook receiver that never loses or repeats an event

items.when: When a payment, shop, CRM or messaging tool sends events and each must be handled once
When the events come from Stripe and checkout, subscriptions and webhooks are built together
When failed or stuck events must raise an alert instead of going unseen
Before merging, to walk through a repeated, late or out-of-order event
When the receiver needs tests for bad signatures, repeats and unknown event types

tasks.task: Fix webhooks that fail, run twice or go missing

items.when: When you have the provider's delivery log or a stack trace and need the cause
When the customer got three emails and nobody can say why, to prove the cause first
When the receiver lacks a signature check, a fast answer or an event store and needs rebuilding
When the fix must come with a failing test first and a pull request a reviewer can follow
After the fix, to confirm a repeat of the same event now changes nothing

tasks.task: Build a client or sync job for another service's API

items.when: When code calls a payment, shop, CRM, messaging or AI service and must survive its failures
When the service answers slow down and you need waiting and backing off done safely
When the service needs OAuth and the right flow and token refresh must be set up
When you are unsure a call matches the service's current docs and want it checked with sources
When the sync runs on a schedule, to read the cron line and catch silent timing mistakes

tasks.task: Add checkout or subscriptions in test mode

items.when: When adding one-off or repeat payments and payment must be confirmed by the provider's event
When billing has upgrades, refunds or failed renewals and money must reconcile to records
When the provider is Stripe and you need checkout, subscriptions and test steps
Before merging payment code, to prove no path can charge or fulfil twice
Before going live, to score the payment and checkout settings and rank the risks

tasks.task: Design tables and write a safe migration

items.when: When the feature is new and you need types, keys, indexes and rules chosen for Postgres
When you write up and down migrations through the client's ORM without locking live tables
When a big live table changes and each step needs its own check and rollback
When a field is renamed or added, to find every place in database, API and screens that reads it

tasks.task: Review write paths for repeats, races and partial failure

items.when: Before merging code that writes data, charges money, sends messages or calls a service
When a service needs its weak spots found: missing timeouts, retries and circuit breakers
When the change has tests, to mark each new behaviour as covered or not
When the design assumes each step succeeds, to ask what the system does when one does not

tasks.task: Review an API for common security weaknesses

items.when: Before launching or opening up an API, or after adding routes, to check your own code
When the review found gaps and each needs a fix, a test and a clear pull request
When keys sit in the code or its history and must be rotated and moved to safe storage

tasks.task: Add input checks and rate limits to routes

items.when: Before writing checks, to find every place outside data enters and which have no filter
When validation and clear error answers must be added at the edge of each route
When routes have no limits and each needs the right window for its kind of traffic

tasks.task: Add sign-in and permissions to an API

items.when: When roles and who may do what were never written down and you need the plan first
When users sign in through another service and the OAuth flow must be built
When the routes are protected, to check each one's sign-in and access rule

tasks.task: Diagnose and fix a bug from an error or log

items.when: When the report is vague and you need repeatable steps and a minimal case
When you have an error, a log or a stack trace and need the cause found
When earlier fixes did not hold and the cause must be proven before code changes
When the client wants a minimal fix, the test gap closed and a pull request
When guesses pile up, to follow what the code really does step by step

tasks.task: Write automated tests for endpoints and integrations

items.when: Before writing tests, to get an ordered list of cases, smallest first
When you have an API spec and need edge, auth and failure cases planned
When each route needs integration and contract tests with fixtures
When new behaviour should be built from a failing test in small steps
When the change feels too big to test, to list the cases and take one small step at a time

tasks.task: Build an endpoint that calls an AI model for one task

items.when: Before the first call, to plan a wrapper that checks budget and records tokens and cost
When the endpoint calls Claude and the request must be written the current way
When the model's reply must come back as checked fields, with a retry on bad output
When the model call needs timeouts, one layer of retries and a fallback
When user text reaches the model, to find and close ways it could be hijacked

tasks.task: Plan how two systems should connect

items.when: When there are several ways to connect them, to compare options with diagrams and trade-offs
When the job is a one-off move from an old tool, with field maps, checks and a way back
When the choice is made, to record why and which options were passed over
When the plan is drafted, to look at the joins between parts and what wins under load

tasks.task: Write an API spec and guard it against breaking changes

items.when: When front end and back end disagree about what an endpoint returns
When the API needs a full OpenAPI spec for docs and client code
When the client's API is GraphQL and the schema, paging and resolvers need design
Before shipping a change, to see who it breaks and a safer way to roll it out
When another team consumes the API, to add tests that catch a break before it ships

tasks.task: Ship an endpoint or integration from brief to production

items.when: When a client needs a new endpoint, webhook, sync or schema change taken all the way live
When the client hands over a written spec and wants a new service with tests and docs
When the branch is ready and reviewers need what changed, why and what to look at
Before asking for review, to catch bugs, missing tests and unclear code yourself

tasks.task: Take an integration live with a checklist and rollback

items.when: When it works in sandbox and you need exact steps, owners and rollback before live
When the change should reach a few users first, with a kill switch
When release day needs checks, a rollback and a way to know it worked
Before deploy, for a read-only look at migrations, config and deploy order

tasks.task: Run the monthly integration and API health check

items.when: Monthly, or after a provider's version notice, a webhook failure spike or a duplicate report
When packages and SDKs should be checked each week for new flaws and updates
When the check shows nobody is told about failures and uptime and alert rules are needed

tasks.task: Add background jobs, queues and scheduled tasks

items.when: When slow work must move off the request into a Redis queue with retries
When a deploy or restart must let workers finish live jobs before they stop
When a job runs on a cron line, to see its next run times and catch mistakes
Before merging a job, to check a retry or double run does no harm

tasks.task: Speed up a slow endpoint

items.when: When something feels slow and you need the bottleneck found, fixed and timed before and after
When one SQL query is the slow step and needs a faster version or an index
When the app is Django and pages fire many near-identical queries
When you need a repeatable speed or load test with a baseline
When tempted to guess, to measure the real path first and cut what is not needed

tasks.task: Add logs, alerts and a runbook for a service

items.when: Before adding anything, to choose the few metrics, logs and alerts that show real harm
When the service has no useful logs and problems must show up fast
When an alert fires and someone needs first steps, fixes and who to tell

tasks.task: Review or refactor back-end code

items.when: When a change needs a ranked review of bugs, security, tests and clarity
When the code has no tests and must be changed without breaking it
When a messy module needs named, small moves that keep its behaviour the same
When reviewing a change, to ask first what it breaks for people already using the code

tasks.task: Send app emails and messages without repeats

items.when: When the app must send receipts, resets or notices with coded templates and a sending set-up
When app emails land in spam and the sending domain's records need fixing
Before merging, to make sure a retry cannot send the same message twice

tasks.task: Write API docs and a README for the service

items.when: When a new developer must run and change the service without asking anyone
Before publishing, to find claims that no longer match the code

always.when: Whenever you change a client's code, to ground each step in their real files and check it
At the end of any coding job, to write what changed, why and the proof that it works

helpers.when: When the job needs schema design for complex rules, slow-query tuning or a risky migration
When the API handles sign-in, payments or personal data and needs a full security review
When the service needs a pipeline, containers or a deploy and rollback plan
When the endpoint needs a screen, a form or a client that handles its errors
When the change needs a wider test plan than endpoint and integration tests
When the AI call needs prompt design, test sets or retrieval, not only a wrapper

gaps: No library item replays real saved webhook payloads as tests, or checks signature and timestamp handling for a named provider
No library item designs idempotency keys, an outbox table or exactly-once handling; only the kit prompts cover repeats
No library item covers database locking, isolation levels or races such as two bookings for one slot
No library item builds a two-way sync between two tools that avoids duplicates and handles conflicts
No library item covers payment providers other than Stripe, such as Razorpay, PayPal or Paddle
No library item tracks a provider's API version and deprecation notices and plans the upgrade
No library item builds an endpoint in FastAPI, Express, Laravel or Rails by name; builders are general or Next.js only
No library item writes an ORM migration for Prisma, SQLAlchemy, Django or Laravel
No library item adds paging, filtering and caching to a slow list endpoint
No library item covers file uploads to object storage with signed links
